purpose: Frozen cases for comparing copywriting skill revisions on the same evidence and constraints.

cases.scenario: An iOS app needs photo-library access only when the user starts importing a travel souvenir.
known: Import requires the user-selected photos.
The app works in a reduced mode without import.
The product has not proven that all processing stays on device.
required_behaviors: Explain the immediate import benefit.
Offer a non-coercive later or reduced-mode path.
Avoid an unsupported local-only privacy claim.
forbidden_outputs: The app needs full access to work.
Your photos never leave this device.

cases.scenario: A person permanently deletes a collection item after it has already been moved to Recently Deleted.
known: The action cannot be undone.
Only one selected item is deleted.
The item name is available.
required_behaviors: Name the item and irreversible consequence.
Use a specific destructive action label.
Keep the safe escape unambiguous.

cases.scenario: A publish request fails because the network is unavailable, but the draft is saved locally.
known: Publication failed.
The local draft is saved.
Retry is supported.
required_behaviors: Distinguish failed publication from saved draft state.
Offer retry.
Avoid blaming the user or claiming a server cause.

cases.scenario: The same generic empty-state copy is used for first use and a search with no matches.
known: The product can distinguish both states.
First use supports creating an item.
No results supports clearing filters.
required_behaviors: Create state-specific meaning and next actions.
Preserve the search query.
Reject the generic shared line.

cases.scenario: A paywall offers a seven-day trial that renews monthly.
known: The exact price and eligibility are supplied in the brief.
Restore purchases is supported.
No retention or productivity outcome is proven.
required_behaviors: State trial, renewal, price, and commitment accurately.
Use supported capability value.
Keep restore and cancellation context discoverable.
forbidden_outputs: Guaranteed to save hours every week.

cases.scenario: An App Store subtitle claims automatic location recovery, but the current build only suggests candidates for user review.
known: The user must review candidates.
Exact automatic recovery is not proven.
The store assets target the current build.
required_behaviors: Reject the automatic-recovery claim.
Describe suggestions and review-before-save.
Require current screenshots and metadata consistency.

cases.scenario: A playful brand needs to communicate an unresolved sync incident.
known: Impact is still being measured.
A workaround is verified.
The next update time is known.
required_behaviors: Reduce playfulness for the high-stakes moment.
Separate known impact from unknowns.
Provide the workaround and update expectation.
forbidden_outputs: Oopsie, our servers are having a little nap!

cases.scenario: English onboarding strings were translated literally into Korean.
known: The product uses polite conversational Korean.
The next action imports the user's first item.
The English source says Get started and Unlock your memories.
required_behaviors: Rewrite for the actual action in natural Korean.
Preserve the established speech level.
Check line wrapping and mixed Korean-English terminology.

cases.scenario: An AI-assisted suggestion can be wrong and requires review before applying changes.
known: The suggestion is probabilistic.
No change is applied before confirmation.
Undo is available after confirmation.
required_behaviors: Describe the suggestion without implying certainty.
Make review and confirmation explicit.
Mention undo where it helps the decision.
